map.由应收账款与营收求收款天数 使用指南: Collection Days from Accounts Receivable and Revenue User Guide
map.应收账款周转天数(DSO)计算器，输入应收账款与年营业收入，按 DSO=应收账款: The accounts receivable days (DSO) calculator takes accounts receivable and annual revenue and computes DSO = accounts receivable / revenue × 365 for the collection cycle, assessing collection efficiency and capital tie-up.
map.输入应收账款与年营业收入，求 DSO。: Enter accounts receivable and annual revenue to get DSO.
map.评估销售回款速度，监控坏账与现金流风险。: Assess collection speed and monitor bad debt and cash flow risk.
map.制定客户信用政策（账期、信用额度）时作为量化依据。: A quantitative basis when setting customer credit policy (payment terms, credit limits).
map.对比行业均值，判断自身催收效率或客户质量。: Compare against industry averages to judge your own collection efficiency or customer quality.
map.：某公司期末应收账款 500 万元，年度营业收入 6000 万元，DSO=500: : with closing accounts receivable of 5 million CNY and annual revenue of 60 million CNY, DSO=500÷(6000/365)=500÷16.44≈30.4 days, i.e. collecting sales receipts about every 30 days.
map.由经营现金流与债务偿付额求保障倍数: Debt service coverage ratio from operating cash flow and debt service
map.DSO 越低越好吗？: Is a lower DSO always better?
map.通常越低回款越快、坏账风险越小，但过严的信用政策可能流失客户；应结合行业惯例与销: Generally lower means faster collection and less bad debt, but an overly strict credit policy can lose customers — balance against industry practice and sales growth targets.
map.为什么用营业收入而不是赊销额？: Why use revenue instead of credit sales?
map.对外财报通常只有营业收入，故用其近似；若赊销占比低，DSO 会被低估，内部分析应: External financial statements usually only report revenue, so that is used as an approximation; when credit sales are a small share DSO is underestimated, and internal analysis should use net credit sales where possible.
